base.name: AI Tool: Node + pnpm
base.description: Install Node.js and pnpm inside Ubuntu from the official Node.js binary archive, with source reachability and download speed checks.

recipe.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v xz >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates xz-utils; fi
VERSION=22.22.3
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case $ARCH in aarch64|arm64) DIST=linux-arm64;; x86_64|amd64) DIST=linux-x64;; *) echo unsupported_arch:$ARCH; exit 11;; esac
URL=https://nodejs.org/dist/v$VERSION/node-v$VERSION-$DIST.tar.xz
TAR=/workspace/.kf/downloads/node-v$VERSION-$DIST.tar.xz
PREFIX=/workspace/.kf/toolchains/node-v$VERSION
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/downloads /workspace/.kf/toolchains /workspace/.kf/bin
METRICS=$(curl -L --fail --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 120 -w '%{http_code} %{speed_download} %{size_download}' -o $TAR $URL)
set -- $METRICS
HTTP=$1
SPEED=${2%.*}
BYTES=${3%.*}
echo [kite] node source http=$HTTP speed=${SPEED}Bps bytes=$BYTES
test $BYTES -gt 1000000
test $SPEED -ge 1024
rm -rf $PREFIX
mkdir -p $PREFIX
tar -xJf $TAR -C $PREFIX --strip-components=1
ln -sf $PREFIX/bin/node /workspace/.kf/bin/node
ln -sf $PREFIX/bin/npm /workspace/.kf/bin/npm
ln -sf $PREFIX/bin/npx /workspace/.kf/bin/npx
export PATH=/workspace/.kf/bin:$PREFIX/bin:$PATH
node --version
npm --version
npm install -g pnpm@10.33.2
ln -sf $PREFIX/bin/pnpm /workspace/.kf/bin/pnpm || true
pnpm --version
echo kite_node_pnpm_install_ok
